Notice to Northbank Community Garden Members and Visitors

Please be advised that the north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while repairs are carried out on a leaking water pipe near the entrance. During this time, all visitors should use the east entrance to access the garden.

Because of the repair work, the seed swap originally planned for Saturday will now take place on Sunday at 11 am. Please bring any clearly labelled seeds you would like to share, and feel free to come along even if you do not have seeds to contribute.

Volunteers helping with the repair area and general tidy-up on Saturday should bring their own gloves. All tools will be supplied by the garden, so there is no need to bring spades, cutters, or other equipment.

Mina will be coordinating volunteers on the day and will meet helpers by the east entrance at 9 am. Thank you for your patience and support while we make this necessary repair and keep the garden safe and welcoming for everyone.

Northbank Community Garden Notice

Please note that the north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while we repair a leaking water pipe near the path. It’s a small job, but it needs clear access and a bit of patience from everyone — better a closed gate for a few hours than a soggy herb bed all spring.

During the closure, please use the east entrance. The main paths will remain open, and you’ll still be able to reach your plots, the compost area, and the shed from that side.

Because of the repair work, the seed swap has been moved to Sunday at 11 am. Bring your spare packets, saved seeds, mystery jars, and hopeful labels. As always, you don’t need to bring seeds to take part.

Volunteers helping on Saturday should bring gloves. Tools will be supplied, so there’s no need to haul your own spade across town unless you’re very attached to it.

Mina will be coordinating volunteers on the day. Please check in with her when you arrive.

Thanks for helping keep Northbank running smoothly.

NOTICE: Northbank Community Garden

The north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while a leaking water pipe is repaired.

Please use the east entrance during this time. The path from the east entrance will remain open to all plots, the compost area, and the shed. If you have a plot near the north fence, allow a few extra minutes to walk around from the east side.

The seed swap planned for Saturday has moved to Sunday at 11 am. Bring seeds in labelled packets if you can. You are also welcome to come along without seeds and take part.

Volunteers are needed on Saturday during the pipe repair window to help keep the area clear and move light items away from the work space. Please bring gloves. Tools will be supplied.

Mina will coordinate volunteers on the day. Check in with her at the east entrance when you arrive.

Thank you for keeping clear of the north gate and the repair area while the work is being done.

Notice to Northbank Community Garden Members and Visitors

The north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm so the leaking water pipe near the entrance can be repaired. While the gate is closed, please use the east entrance to reach the garden.

The seed swap planned for Saturday will move to Sunday at 11 am. Bring any clearly labelled seeds you would like to share, or come along to browse and meet other gardeners.

Volunteers helping on Saturday should bring gloves. Tools will be supplied by the garden, so you do not need to bring your own equipment. Mina will coordinate the volunteer work and will meet helpers at the east entrance at 9 am.

Thank you for working around the closure and helping us get the pipe fixed quickly. We appreciate everyone’s patience while access is limited at the north gate.
